title: Design System: Site Safety Watch Command Wall

headline.purpose: Names Site Safety Watch in the masthead.

title.purpose: Labels spatial, response and incident lanes.

body.purpose: Carries findings, rules, captions and empty-state guidance.

label.purpose: Carries status, metadata, controls and measured figures.

shadows.name: hazard-overlay
shadows.purpose: Separates the full-width hazard field from moving camera evidence.

shadows.name: evidence-legibility
shadows.purpose: Keeps camera identity and source labels readable over footage.

motion.name: incident-enter
motion.purpose: Reveals a newly observed incident once with a horizontal clip.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Collapses interface animation when reduced motion is requested.

components.name: Command Index
components.description: The safety-lime SW block that anchors the masthead.
components.css: .ds-command-index { width:42px; height:42px; display:grid; place-items:center; color:var(--black,#090b0c); background:var(--safety,#d8ff3f); font-family:var(--font,"Barlow Condensed","Arial Narrow",sans-serif); font-size:1.15rem; font-weight:900; letter-spacing:-.02em; }

components.name: System Cell
components.description: A ruled status cell for local service state and update time.
components.css: .ds-system-cell { min-width:112px; display:grid; gap:4px; padding:10px 13px; border-right:1px solid var(--line,#39444a); color:var(--dim,#849198); background:transparent; font-family:var(--font,"Barlow Condensed","Arial Narrow",sans-serif); font-size:.65rem; letter-spacing:.07em; text-decoration:none; text-transform:uppercase; } .ds-system-cell strong { color:var(--clear,#5bd6c0); font-size:.76rem; font-weight:800; } .ds-system-cell:hover { background:var(--panel-raised,#1d2529); } .ds-system-cell:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--safety,#d8ff3f); outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Active Hazard Field
components.description: The full-width state field attached to the bottom of camera evidence.
components.css: .ds-hazard-field { display:grid; grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) auto; align-items:end; gap:18px; padding:18px 20px; color:var(--black,#090b0c); background:var(--safety,#d8ff3f); box-shadow:0 18px 38px rgba(0,0,0,.45); font-family:var(--font,"Barlow Condensed","Arial Narrow",sans-serif); text-transform:uppercase; } .ds-hazard-field strong { display:block; font-size:2.4rem; line-height:.88; font-weight:900; letter-spacing:-.035em; } .ds-hazard-field span { display:block; margin-top:8px; font-size:.72rem; font-weight:800; letter-spacing:.05em; } .ds-hazard-field b { font-size:3rem; line-height:.8; font-weight:900; text-align:right; } .ds-hazard-field small { display:block; margin-top:9px; font-size:.65rem; letter-spacing:.08em; }

components.name: Module Heading
components.description: A compact ruled header shared by spatial and response lanes.
components.css: .ds-module-heading { min-height:58px; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; gap:12px; padding:11px 13px; border-bottom:1px solid var(--line-soft,#293238); color:var(--paper,#f1f2ec); background:var(--shell,#101416); font-family:var(--font,"Barlow Condensed","Arial Narrow",sans-serif); text-transform:uppercase; } .ds-module-heading strong { display:block; font-size:.95rem; font-weight:900; letter-spacing:-.01em; } .ds-module-heading span { display:block; margin-top:4px; color:var(--dim,#849198); font-size:.66rem; font-weight:600; letter-spacing:.05em; } .ds-module-heading b { color:var(--clear,#5bd6c0); font-size:.65rem; font-weight:900; letter-spacing:.08em; }

components.name: Active Orbit Control
components.description: A compact square text control for the spatial reconstruction.
components.css: .ds-orbit-control { min-height:28px; padding:5px 8px; border:1px solid var(--line-soft,#293238); border-radius:0; color:var(--black,#090b0c); background:var(--safety,#d8ff3f); font-family:var(--font,"Barlow Condensed","Arial Narrow",sans-serif); font-size:.6rem; font-weight:800; letter-spacing:.04em; text-transform:uppercase; cursor:pointer; } .ds-orbit-control:hover { color:var(--paper,#f1f2ec); background:var(--panel-raised,#1d2529); } .ds-orbit-control:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--safety,#d8ff3f); outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Selected Incident
components.description: A selected entry in the full-width incident tape.
components.css: .ds-incident { width:100%; display:grid; grid-template-columns:50px minmax(0,1fr) auto; align-items:center; gap:10px; padding:12px 14px; border:0; border-right:1px solid var(--line,#39444a); border-radius:0; color:var(--black,#090b0c); background:var(--safety,#d8ff3f); font-family:var(--font,"Barlow Condensed","Arial Narrow",sans-serif); text-align:left; cursor:pointer; } .ds-incident time { opacity:.72; font-size:.66rem; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; } .ds-incident strong { display:block; font-size:.76rem; } .ds-incident small { display:block; margin-top:3px; opacity:.72; font-size:.65rem; text-transform:uppercase; } .ds-incident b { font-size:.6rem; letter-spacing:.04em; text-transform:uppercase; } .ds-incident:hover { background:var(--clear,#5bd6c0); } .ds-incident:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--safety,#d8ff3f); outline-offset:-5px; }

components.name: Stored Rule Block
components.description: A flat zinc inset for the stored safety rule and proposed fix.
components.html:
Keep designated exit routes unobstructed.

MOVE THE OBSTRUCTION AND VERIFY CLEARANCE.
components.css: .ds-rule-block { padding:9px 10px; color:var(--muted,#b3bec3); background:var(--panel-raised,#1d2529); border-radius:0; font-family:var(--font,"Barlow Condensed","Arial Narrow",sans-serif); font-size:.7rem; line-height:1.38; } .ds-rule-block p { margin:0; } .ds-rule-block strong { display:block; margin-top:5px; color:var(--paper,#f1f2ec); font-weight:600; }

narrative.overview:
Site Safety Watch is a fixed-lane operational wallboard, not a dashboard assembled from cards. One live or recorded camera owns the field, while spatial reconstruction and the human response record form a compact verification stack at the right. The incident tape runs below both so the whole detection and disposition story reads in one sweep.

The world is industrial, flat and decisive. Zinc-black surfaces reduce glare, paper-white type stays legible at a distance, and high-visibility color appears as an earned field tied to a real state. Barlow Condensed gives the wall the density and authority of site signage without adding ornament. Rules, fixed lanes and hard edges create structure instead of floating containers.
keyCharacteristics: The camera is the dominant source of truth.
Spatial evidence and response stay in a fixed right-hand stack.
The incident tape preserves chronology across the full lower edge.
Status is always stated in text and reinforced by color.
Every runtime claim and measurement comes from the local Dell Pro Max GB10.

rules.name: The Earned Signal Rule
rules.body: Lime, red, teal and amber always communicate a named operational state. Never use them as decoration.

rules.name: The Text Before Color Rule
rules.body: Every status remains understandable when the signal color is unavailable.

rules.name: The Distance Read Rule
rules.body: The product name, camera identity, hazard, zone and status must read before supporting evidence at wallboard distance.

rules.name: The Condensed Voice Rule
rules.body: Barlow Condensed is the only interface family. Hierarchy comes from weight, scale and case, not font mixing.

rules.name: The Fixed Lane Rule
rules.body: Camera, spatial evidence, response and incident tape keep their rank at every width, even when the lanes stack.

rules.name: The Ruled Surface Rule
rules.body: Establish hierarchy with tone and rules. Shadow is reserved for information physically overlaid on camera evidence.

rules.name: The No Card Silhouette Rule
rules.body: Never wrap modules in rounded rectangles. A module is a lane bounded by rules.

dos: Do let the live or recorded camera dominate the wall.
Do preserve the camera, spatial reconstruction, response and incident-tape order on mobile.
Do use safety lime for active evidence and focus, red for the camera source, amber for approved work and teal only for confirmed clearance.
Do pair every color state with direct text.
Do show honest loading, empty, unavailable and offline states.
Do keep the local-runtime truth visible in the footer.
donts: Don't introduce rounded cards, floating tiles, decorative gradients or ambient glows.
Don't turn the wall into a grid of equal metrics.
Don't invent measurements, confidence, status or evidence.
Don't use a cloud platform name or imply that inference leaves the Dell Pro Max GB10.
Don't add a second typeface, emoji or decorative stock imagery.
